plan.title: SHG Loan Insights
plan.subtitle: Repayment status and loan purpose distribution

panels.title: Total Loans
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Overdue Loans
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register WHERE "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue'

panels.title: Overdue Rate
panels.sql: SELECT (COUNT(CASE WHEN "Repayment Status" = 'Overdue' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) AS overdue_rate FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Repayment Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT "Repayment Status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Loan Purposes
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Loan Purposes
panels.sql: SELECT "Purpose", COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

plan.narrative: The SHG loan program has issued {{p1}} total loans, with {{p2}} currently overdue ({{p3}}% of total). The repayment status distribution is visualized in {{p4}}, showing the proportion of loans in each category. The primary purposes for which loans are taken are detailed in {{p5}}, and the top five purposes are listed in {{p6}}.
